title: Who supplies the external utility lines for a turnkey titanium-plate roller-hearth furnace?
summary: Even a “turnkey” scope needs separate utility, power and foundation handover points. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s titanium-plate roller-hearth furnace proposal dated 4 March 2025 sets utility-piping handover 1.5 m outside the equipment and electrical handover at the incoming side of the distribution cabinet's main switch. These concern different work; one distance line cannot define all site responsibilities.
